liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Stella Blue** (3 reviews): The solo is called breathtaking, one of the rare magical moments of the Vince era; Reviewer says Stella alone makes the show worth hearing [11][12][15]
- **Stranger** (2 reviews): Reviewer finds the opener hot, with Vince playing energetically; Reviewer was awestruck from the opening Stranger onward [9][14]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (2 reviews): China Rider is called hot; China>Rider is called hot [10][12]
- **Stagger Lee** (1 review): Singled out as a really good rendition, along with Broken Arrow, setting up Eternity [7]
- **Loose Lucy** (1 review): Vince's keyboard playing is all over it, with carnival-like riffing and tight backing vocals on a refrain [9]
- **Broken Arrow** (1 review): Praised as a really good rendition that helps set up a strong Eternity [7]
- **He's Gone** (1 review): He's Gone called good [15]

## Setlist highlights

- **Stranger**: back after 185 archived shows (990 days) [19]
- **China Cat**: back after 172 archived shows (912 days) [19]
- **Vince's Greeting**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [19]

## The recordings

- **gd1994-03-05.sbd.sailor_saint.33585.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 19 songs; 156 min; rated 4/5 by 3 [1]. Said about its sound: Uploader fixed low levels and misplaced first-set track markers, boosting levels by 20% with Pyro 5 while preserving all music [1]
- **gd94-03-05.sbd.kidder.8331.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 155 min; rated 3.53/5 by 19 [3]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls the soundboard sound quality good; Reviewer finds the recording thin with no bass, and the kick drum panned hard right sounds weak; Vocals sound excellent and Jerry's guitar is shimmering and lively [7][18]
- **gd1994-03-05.152012.sbd.latvala.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 152 min [2]
- **gd1994-03-05.AKG451.Darby.119533.Flac1644**: audience recording; 18 songs; 153 min; rated 1.33/5 by 3 [4]

## Around the show

- Reviewer notes Healy was fired after this run [10]
- Reviewer says Healy was fired as an enabler, supplying substances in blatant ways [11]
- This was the only tough ticket of the run; the crowd stormed the fences at the brand new venue during Stagger Lee [12]
- Reviewer recalls Healy mixing Bob's sound down, causing friction with Bob and contributing to Healy's dismissal [13]
- Reviewer's first Dead show, attended at age 15 after a friend encouraged them; it changed their life [14]
- Reviewer cites Phil's book: Healy angered Weir by altering his vocals during songs like The Other One [16]
- Reviewer heard Cutler's first show as soundman was 3-16-94, but cannot confirm the source [16]
- Dan Healy's last shows as soundman; he was interviewed by Jim Blackwood and John Bradford before the show on March 5 [2]
- Reviewer rates Vince's playing here his best ever, matched only by a Boston Garden show on 10-3-94 [9]
- Reviewer considers this the best show of this run [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1994-03-05.sbd.sailor_saint.33585.flac16**: transferred by C. Allen; source: SBD > ? > CDR (see info file) [1]. Also: Original CDs came from Dick Latvala around summer 1999 to a Dead-themed radio show; uploader copied from the host [1]
- **gd94-03-05.sbd.kidder.8331.sbeok.shnf**: source: DSBD --> DAT --> CDR [3]. Also: Lineage is DSBD to DAT to CDR, via Charlie Kidder [3]
- **gd1994-03-05.152012.sbd.latvala.flac16**: transferred by Fresh transfer and mastering by Jim Blackwood Sony R-500 to Tascam DA-3000 [2020] Track FLAC and Pack by Mark Goldey; source: SBD > DAT 44.1 kHz [2]
- **gd1994-03-05.AKG451.Darby.119533.Flac1644**: taped by Mike Darby; transferred by Keo; source: Master Audience Recorded By Mr. Darby; AKG451EB/CK1's (DIN/DFC/First 1/4 Of OTS/9 Feet High)> Whirlwind Phantoms>Teac DA-P20 @ 16/48; Transfer Information:Sony… [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Desert Sky Pavilion - March 5, 1994](https://www.dead.net/show/march-5-1994) [20]
